*Dashboard developed by Kiran using the Plotly R package, data from NOAA*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(rnoaa)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Get a list of all NY station IDs
nyc_noaa_df <-read_csv("/Users/kuiyan/Desktop/R Projects/kirankui.github.io/data/nynoaadat.csv")

nyc_noaa_df = nyc_noaa_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, date, tmax, tmin, everything()) %>% 
  filter(date >= as.Date("2010-07-01") & date <= as.Date("2010-08-31")) %>% 
  drop_na(id, date, tmax, tmin) %>% 
  mutate(tmax_c = tmax/10,
         tmax_f = tmax_c*1.8 + 32)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
box_ggplot = 
  nyc_noaa_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax_f, fill = factor(date))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
   labs(
    title = "Daily Maximum Temperature Distribution across NY in July-Aug 2010",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum Temperature (°F)",
    fill = "Date"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ggplotly(box_ggplot)

```
